name: What is the process for replacing a cracked patio door glass pane?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing a cracked patio door glass pane?

acceptedAnswer.text: The replacement process typically involves several steps. First, we secure the area and carefully remove the damaged glass pane from the door frame. We then measure the opening precisely to ensure the new glass fits perfectly. The new, custom-cut glass unit is then installed, sealed, and glazed into the existing door frame. Finally, we clean up the site and ensure the door operates smoothly and securely. Most replacements can be completed in a single visit once the new glass unit is fabricated.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing damaged glass, precisely measuring, installing a new custom-cut pane, sealing it, and ensuring proper door operation.
